FICTIONAL EXAMPLE — not a real fund, not a recommendation

# BASE Consumer Szn

> Pre-TGE consumer apps on Base, before CT notices. I've shipped two Base mini-apps to 40k users and I fund the builders I already ship alongside.

## Policy card

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Sectors | other |
| Instruments | equity, token-warrant |
| Stage | pre-token |
| Chains | Base |
| Strategy style | conviction |
| Risk profile | aggressive |
| Positions | 12 |
| Governance | manager-discretion |
| Investor eligibility | club |
| Time horizon | 1-3yr |
| Target allocation | |
| — consumer apps | 70% |
| — reserves | 30% |
| — sum of the rows above | 100% |

**The bet.** Base app installs went from a trickle to a flood after the mini-app surface shipped, and the builders I ship alongside are raising now.

**Why me.** I shipped two Base mini-apps to 40k users and my wallet is public; I fund the builders I already ship alongside.

**Sourcing.** Builders I already ship alongside, the Base builder group chats, and inbound from my own app users.

**How it's built.** $25k to $75k per position, occasionally more for a second cheque.

**Positions.** 12

**Liquid / locked split.** 70% deployed, 30% held back for follow-ons.

**Getting out.** Redemption at epoch settlement, twelve-month lockup from deposit, no secondary.

**Lockups.** I am locked on the same terms as depositors: twelve months, no early release.

**Won't touch.** No memecoins, no pure infrastructure plays, nothing already post-TGE.

**Terms & transparency.** $1.5M for the first School.

**Investor eligibility.** club

**Transparency.** Multisig address published, monthly PnL post, live dashboard.

**Governance.** manager-discretion

**Points & incentives.** Depositors earn Fish Points for sourcing deals I invest in.

**Value add.** I introduce founders to the Base teams I ship with and review their mini-app before launch.

**Rules.** No position above 20% of the book; I do not add after a token generation event.

**Benchmark.** outperform ETH
